subject: SOC2 evidence: consolidated VM scan notebook + remediation attestation (FinPlatform request)
messages:
From: Diane Xu <security@finplatform.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC2 VM evidence and remediation attestation

Hi Marissa / Kim (cc Ben),

We're kicking off the SOC2 evidence collection for FinPlatform's Q2 audit. The assessor has asked for a single consolidated "VM evidence notebook" that contains the following for Redwood's environment covering the last 12 months: 

- Scan cadence summary (schedules, technologies, coverage)
- Recent/full scan indexes (CSV or spreadsheet)
- CVE remediation timelines (ticket references + closure dates)
- SLA definitions for severity buckets and any exceptions
- Two anonymized example CVEs: one high/one critical showing detection -> triage -> remediation timeline
- A short remediation attestation (signed PDF) that we can include in the SOC2 pack

Can you confirm you can provide this by June 15? Prefer CSV/Excel attachments for indexes and a one-page signed attestation PDF. Also let me know if you need permission to include sanitized CVE identifiers (we don't need source IPs or any customer identifiers).

If you prefer, we can accept an initial draft by June 8 and a final signed version by June 15. Assessor (Crowne Audit) will review the notebook and may request follow-ups.

Thanks — appreciate the help.

Diane Xu
Head of Security Operations
FinPlatform

Attachments requested: scan index template (CSV), remediation manifest template (XLSX)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Xu <security@finplatform.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 VM evidence and remediation attestation

Diane — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely produce a consolidated notebook and a signed attestation. Plan below: 

1) Deliverables (what we'll attach)
   - vm-scan-index.csv (master index: scan id, host/service, scanner, findings count, date)
   - remediation-manifest.xlsx (ticket id, severity, assigned owner, open->closed timestamps, PR/patch ref)
   - attestation-draft.docx (one-page attestation for you to share with the auditor)
   - scan-cadence-diagram.png (visual of weekly/daily runs + internal delta checks)

2) SLA summary (short):
   - Critical: 72 hours to remediation plan, aim to close within 7 days where feasible
   - High: acknowledged within 24 hours, remediation target 7-30 days depending on risk
   - Medium/Low: scheduled per release window, typical 30-90 days

3) Scan cadence: weekly full authenticated scan (Nessus), daily lightweight registry scans for container images, and continuous image CI checks (Snyk + GH Dependabot). We'll include the historical schedule and coverage table.

4) CVE examples: we'll include two sanitized examples (CVE-XXXX-YYYY style) with ticket links and timelines. We will not include any customer-identifying data.

5) Proposed timeline: initial package (CSV/XLSX + attestation draft) by EOD Jun 8, signed PDF by Jun 15. If Crowne needs DocuSign, we can provide that link for signature.

I've attached the initial files (attestation-draft.docx, vm-scan-index.csv, remediation-manifest.xlsx). Ben, Kim — can you confirm the SLA wording above and add any technical caveats? Also, do we want to include the Jira ticket references (SUP- ids) in the sanitized notebook or just links to the ticket tracker?

Regards,

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Diane Xu <security@finplatform.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 VM evidence and remediation attestation

Quick clarifications from ops side:

- SLA details: wording looks good but add an explicit "time to mitigation plan" for Critical = 24 hours to mitigation plan (not just acknowledgement) in case of active exploitation. We'll add that to the attestation text as a parenthetical.

- Scan cadence: 
  * Full authenticated host scans: weekly (Nessus)
  * Container image scanning: on every image build (CI) + nightly registry scan
  * Dependency SCA: daily pulls + weekly policy sweep
  * Internal endpoint scanning: monthly internal net scans (authenticated)

- Ticket references: we should include ticket IDs but redact any customer references. We typically include "SUP-1234" style links — if the auditor wants to click through, we can provide read-only access. For the notebook we'll put ticket ID + public-issue-summary + closed date.

- Evidence runbook snippet (paste):
  1) Detection (scanner alert) -> 2) Create SUP ticket (auto-create) -> 3) Triage (sec eng + owner) -> 4) Workaround/deploy mitigation -> 5) Patch -> 6) Post-patch scan -> 7) Close + annotate CVE timeline

I've attached scan-cadence-diagram.png to the thread (visual) — use that in the evidence pack.

Ben
Security PM, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: scan-cadence-diagram.png

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Diane — attaching the finalized, signed attestation (signed-attestation.pdf) and the consolidated evidence notebook (CSV/XLSX + diagram).

Summary of what we provided:
- vm-scan-index.csv: all scans for the last 12 months (scanner, scan id, scope, finding counts, dates)
- remediation-manifest.xlsx: SUP ticket id, severity, owner, open/close timestamps, patch reference
- scan-cadence-diagram.png: visual schedule and technologies used
- signed-attestation.pdf: one-page attestation signed by me on behalf of Redwood Inference

We have redacted customer-identifying metadata and included SUP- references where appropriate. For the two CVE examples we included ticket links and the timeline from discovery -> patch -> verification; if the auditor needs deeper logs we can grant time-limited read-only access to the ticket tracker (we'll need to coordinate with your assessor).

DocuSign: if you prefer DocuSign, please send the link; otherwise this attached signed PDF should satisfy Crowne Audit for the SOC2 evidence bundle.

Thanks — please confirm receipt and let us know if you need additional artifacts.

Best,
